title: Replicating TEMPEST at Scale: Multi-Turn Adversarial Attacks Against Trillion-Parameter Frontier Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical robustness of LLMs against multi-turn adversarial jailbreak attacks. While it evaluates the model's ability to refuse harmful prompts (which can include hate speech), it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical reasoning frameworks as a primary component.
